name: watchlog
description: Self-hosted watch history logger for Jellyfin users.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @watchlog/api & npm run dev -w @watchlog/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @watchlog/shared && npm run build -w @watchlog/web && npm run build -w @watchlog/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @watchlog/shared && npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck -w @watchlog/api && npm run typecheck -w @watchlog/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @watchlog/shared && npm run lint -w @watchlog/api && npm run lint -w @watchlog/web
scripts.test: npm run test:compose && npm run test:docker-context && npm run build -w @watchlog/shared && npm run test -w @watchlog/api && npm run test -w @watchlog/web && npm run test -w @watchlog/shared
